# US-003: Assign members to a project

## User Story

As a Admin, I want to assign Leap Up members and clients to a project, so that each person sees exactly the projects they work on.

## Context

Quote P1 #1 "phân quyền theo project (Leap Up / Client)".

## Linked Requirements

| FR | Priority | Notes |
|----|----------|-------|
| [FR-admin-007](../srs/admin-spec.md#3-functional-requirements-fr) | P0 | Assign members |

## Acceptance Criteria

<!-- DRAFT — generated by /ac from the draft SRS · AC must be confirmed by PO/QA before it is final -->

### AC-001 — Member assigned

- **Type:** happy-path
- **Covers:** FR-admin-007 / BR-admin-002, 003
- **Screen:** TBD

```gherkin
Scenario Outline: assign a member
Given project "711" and account "<user>"
When the Admin assigns "<user>" to "711" with role <role>
Then "<user>" sees "711" after signing in

Examples:
  | user        | role    |
  | nguyen.an   | Client  |
  | {Leap Up member account — creation blocked by spec OQ-2} | Leap Up |
```

### AC-002 — Not assigned, not visible

- **Type:** permission
- **Covers:** BR-admin-002 / FR-admin-007 (the full visibility test is owned by auth-access US-002 AC-001)
- **Screen:** TBD

```gherkin
Given "nguyen.an" is not assigned to "Grab Transport"
When "nguyen.an" signs in
Then "Grab Transport" is not listed
```

### AC-003 — Duplicate or invalid assignment

- **Type:** error-path · **blocked by spec OQ-10** (no error code or wording yet)
- **Covers:** FR-admin-007

```gherkin
Scenario Outline: invalid assignment
Given <situation>
When the Admin saves the assignment
Then {result decided in OQ-10}

Examples:
  | situation                                   |
  | "nguyen.an" is already a member of "711"     |
  | the chosen user does not exist               |
  | the chosen user is an Admin                  |
```
